source: Ravi et al Nature Genetics2023 SU2C-MARK; Zenodo11179623 v3
source_design: Pretreatment FFPE tumor from anti-PD(L)1-treated advanced NSCLC; published393 total is not RNA sample count
acquisition: Only public harmonized TPM GCT and author clinical XLSX/TXT ZIP members; HTTP Range preserves whole original archive untouched; per-member CRC/SHA, not whole archive checksum
clinical: Exact sample/patient/pretreatment and response/time/event mapping; mapping or timing ambiguity stays unavailable. Repeat samples average within patient. Source counts and event codes verified before effects.
model: Same minimal panT-adjusted logistic/Cox and eligibility gates, separate fresh external families. Age/sex/histology/liver/line additional descriptive controls only when measurable and identifiable; no tuning.
validation_boundary: Bulk functional proxy association only, not exact subcluster/CM recovery, causal communication or independent clinical predictor.
overlap_review: Study/paper/centre/trial patient history checked against prior sources; no assumption that393 all have RNA or constitute new patients.
raw_controlled_fallback: phs002822.v1.p1: prepare request scope for authorized institutional PI/IRB if raw files become necessary; do not fabricate identity or submit contact messages.
